review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, design self-review based on independent findings P1 and P2
review.decision: Preserve the existing v2 native claim format and the original unavailable-target marker when admitting a bound rotation briefing.
review.notes: Use separate offline processes for the writer and recovery on the v1.0.195 baseline and the candidate. Simulate an interrupted publication without a live receiver.

cases.description: Interrupted bound briefing claims remain readable by the previous native journal reader
cases.setup: Queue an addressed synthetic briefing and persist real prepared, uncertain, and accepted-before-cleanup states in private homes. Use fake transport and separate baseline and candidate test processes.
cases.action: Drain a workspace tick and protected Relay using the baseline, then repeat with the candidate. Compare the original intent, pinned claim and exact receipt across recovery boundaries.
cases.expected: No briefing is submitted again. Prepared becomes uncertain, uncertain keeps the original batch, and accepted closes only after persisting the exact independent-proof receipt. The ordinary tick and protected Relay still submit separately from the briefing and no keys are sent.

cases.description: A lone Relay opportunity still diagnoses an unavailable HQ target
cases.setup: Use a private queue with one true due Relay reservation and an identified idle-looking fake composer without a native route or verified legacy identity.
cases.action: Drain and inspect native and key counts, the Relay queue and the original target-unavailable issue.
cases.expected: The Relay is retained, no input runs, and the existing target-unavailable issue is recorded.
